adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the attacker-controlled `url` (only guarded by `/^https?\:\/\//`) is interpolated directly into HTML: `"#{url}"` and appended into `contents`. The created post is explicitly marked `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` unchanged for `:raw_html`. The embed view renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>`, so no escaping/sanitization occurs. Separately, `EmbedController#best` enqueues `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` using the request `embed_url`, and `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, @embed_url)` when the host matches `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`. Therefore, an unauthenticated request can cause a stored raw-HTML post containing an unescaped, attacker-shaped URL, enabling attribute injection/XSS via quotes in the URL.
